shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, a shipped known-issue library plus a benign "no-concern" library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs, an optional Circinus corpus-prevalence bridge, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a glossary), a global knowledge-base browser, an in-game bug/fix report composer, a suite-styled mod-settings page in parity with the Modules window, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT).

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` is banned suite-wide with one deliberate exception: the dev palette's category line (see Tool 3). Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField` = suite-styled single-line text/search field. `Palette.ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight` = shared full-width settings row (label + right-side switch + optional measured/wrapped dim description; whole row is the click target) used by both settings surfaces. Also `DrawCard`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`.
- **Text-scaling rule:** never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window` — the matrix is applied outside the window's GUI clip, so labels render in screen space (they appeared floating over the map). Use the three built-in fonts and size every text rect from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source (ranked culprits) → "What this means" (diagnoses, sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks (glossary) → report card → stack trace.
- **Auto-open suppression toggle (settings, off by default): `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`.** `Patch_CheckOpenLogWindow` suppresses auto-open while `ProgramState.Entry`; still auto-opens in-game; manual open always works.
- **Toolbar B buttons (right→left):** Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, **Knowledge base** (`MDT_KbButton`, opens `Window_KnowledgeBase`), then the search field fills the rest.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule — read before adding a module)
`ErrorDiagnosis.Score` sorts the "What this means" list descending. The scale is **single digits**, and it is not self-evident from any one file:
- `Module_ModIssues` 9 + (n−i) — the author's own shipped fix ranks top
- `Module_CommunityBugs` 8 + (n−i); `Module_DependencyCheck` 8–8.5; `Module_AboutIncompat` 7; `Module_Community` 6–7; `Module_HarmonyPatches` 4.5–6.5; `Module_VersionMismatch` 5
- `Module_KnownIssues` **n − i** — a lone curated match scores just **1** (benign entries get +1000 to pin the reassuring card to the top)
Consequence: a curated library entry is numerically the *lowest*-scoring real diagnosis, so any new module that merely adds context must score **< 1** to sit below it. Two-digit scores silently pin a module to the top of every error.

### Knowledge-base content & factual-provenance convention
The shipped knowledge is spread across four libraries. **Factuality rule: every match string must be a verbatim engine string, verified against decompiled Verse/RimWorld source, and every data entry carries a `source file:line` provenance comment** so any maintainer can re-confirm it. Unbiased rule: shipped defs never name a third-party mod (attribution stays runtime-computed from the stack); `fix` text is always user-actionable ("update / check dependencies / report the trace"), never "mod X is bad". Specific-mod claims live only in the community DB behind `verified`/`reportedBy` flags. Current inventory:
- **`Defs/KnownIssueDefs.xml` — 40 always-on entries.** Sections: load-time mod metadata warnings; exceptions; **startup & initialization** (`MDT_StaticConstructor`, `MDT_UninitializedDefOf`, `MDT_ConfigErrors`); def/XML data problems (incl. `MDT_CustomXmlLoader`); patches/load-order/save-load (incl. `MDT_LoadIdReference` for loadID object refs, `MDT_SaveVersionMismatch` [ignorable], `MDT_LongEventException`); pawn AI/jobs/world state (`MDT_JobException` also catches `exception interval ticking`); common .NET exceptions; content/quests/UI. `MDT_RootOnGUI` broadened to cover both `Root.OnGUI()` and `Root.Update()` top-level per-frame exceptions.
- **`Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml` — 5 benign "no concern" lines** (version banner, command line, save-data override, new-game/loaded-save mod lists). Anchored patterns only; must never swallow a real error.
- **`Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — 17 verified generic patterns** (our contributor-editable DB). Newest three: `worldgen-player-faction-missing` ("Could not find player faction" flood in world/map gen — no trace on the plain line; explains the dev-mode-trace workaround), `cross-map-reservation-failure` (per-map reservation of an off-map target), `hediff-interval-tick-exception` (a hediff's per-tick code threw → hediff auto-removed).
- **Glossary — ~26 plain-language terms** (see below).

### Benign "no concern" classification
Normal no-fault vanilla log lines classified via `KnownIssueDef.benign` (curated in `Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml`). `KnownIssueIndex.HasBenignMatch(ctx)` runs before the module loop (only when `msg.type != Error`), sets `ctx.Benign`; while set, `ErrorContext.Merge` no-ops all attribution. Inspector shows a green "No concern" badge, forces impact to Info, hides the report card.

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module: `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses sorted by `Score`. Modules: `Module_StackTrace`, `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions`, `Module_HarmonyPatches`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_Community`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_CircinusCorpus`, `Module_Glossary`. All 13 defs live in the single flat `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`.
- **Index prewarm** (`Bootstrap` → `InstalledModIndex.Prewarm()` off-thread). Harmony index built lazily on first analysis.
- **Harmony patch-owner attribution** (`HarmonyIndex` + `Module_HarmonyPatches`): reverse-maps `"Type.FullName:Method" → owner-id[]`. Diagnosis when ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace. Self excluded.
- **Proactive dependency & load-order scan** (`ModDependencyIndex` + `Module_DependencyCheck`, order 60): mirrors vanilla `GetModWarnings`/`FindConflicts`.
- **Plain-language glossary** (`Glossary` + `Module_Glossary`, `DrawSection`, order 900). ~26 terms, each with a `MDT_Gl*`/`MDT_Gl*Def` Keyed pair. `TermsIn` scans the error + its diagnoses (cap raised to 8 shown); `AllTerms` feeds the knowledge browser. Terms: harmony, transpiler, cross-reference, def, xpath, patch operation, stack trace, null reference, TPS, FPS, load order, packageId, HugsLib, type-load, comp, hediff, tick, scribe, loadID, DefOf, gizmo, ITab, mote, assembly/DLL, prefix/postfix, DLC.

### Circinus bridge (`Module_CircinusCorpus`, def `MDT_CircinusCorpus`, order 140)
Optional compat module reporting what our sibling mod **Circinus**'s shared corpus knows about the selected error (how many installs see it). Gated on `<requiresPackageId>astryl.Circinus</requiresPackageId>`, so it is absent from the module list — and the probe never runs — without Circinus.
- **Reflection, never a reference.** Binds `Circinus.KnownIssues` via `GenTypes.GetTypeInAnyAssembly` + `GetMethod`, using only the string→string primitives Circinus froze for this purpose (`Describe`, `ImplicatedMod`). A compile-time reference would make the two DLLs a dependency pair and force a load order; neither mod references the other and either can ship alone.
- **Probe is one-shot and fails loudly *only* when it matters:** type missing = Circinus not installed, stays silent forever. Type present but methods unmatched = the contract drifted → one `Log.WarningOnce`, because a reflection bridge that goes quietly dormant is precisely the failure mode this mod exists to catch. Any throw nulls *every* binding (a half-probed bridge is worse than none).
- **`Score = 0.5f`** — deliberately below the curated `KnownIssueDef` floor of 1 (see the Score-scale section), so prevalence always sorts *last*. A shipped entry explains the fault; this only says how widespread it is. Prevalence is context for a diagnosis, not a diagnosis. `Ignorable = true` (informational, mutable via ignore key `MDT_Module_CircinusCorpus`).
- **Attribution at `WeightKnownAttr * 0.5f` = 2.0** — under `WeightMessageName` (2.5) and far under `WeightStackBase` (5), so a corpus correlation can add a name to the culprit list but can never reorder it above a mod with an actual frame in the trace. Only fires when Circinus consented to name a mod, which needs ≥25 affected and ≥25 unaffected runs — dormant on a thin corpus.
- **Explanation text is passed through verbatim** from Circinus's `Describe` (it builds its own install counts and an evidence-gated correlation clause); only the card title and attribution reason are ours/Keyed (`MDT_CorpusTitle`, `MDT_ReasonCorpusCorrelation`).
- **Open contract risk:** `ImplicatedMod` is public in Circinus but is *not* listed in that class's "treat as frozen once published" doc block — worth adding there, or our attribution path silently dies on a rename.

### Settings surfaces — parity contract
Two **distinct** layouts sharing the `Palette` visual language; internal rule documented in `Documentation/UI-Parity.md` + checklist comments on `ModernDevToolsSettings`, `SettingsPage`, and `Dialog_Modules`.
- **`ModernDevToolsSettings`** — all user-facing settings: `moduleEnabled`, `ignoredIssues`, `enableCommunityData`, `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`, `experimentalWindowHardening`, `experimentalMapUiHardening` (+ internal `lastSeenVersion`).
- **Mod-settings page (`SettingsPage.Draw`, canonical superset)** — replaced the old clipped `Listing_Standard`/`CheckboxLabeled` page. A single scrolling column of suite cards: **General** (auto-open toggle), **Analysis modules** (intro + full module list with provenance tags + toggles), **Ignored warnings** (Clear all + Remove rows / empty state), **Community data** (enable toggle + Update info + status), **Experimental hardening** (2 toggles). Reserves the 16px scrollbar gutter unconditionally and sizes every rect by measurement (`Text.CalcHeight`/`Palette.ToggleRowHeight`) so descriptions never clip and there's no reflow flicker; `_lastHeight` feeds next frame's viewRect. `DoSettingsWindowContents` is now a one-liner into `SettingsPage.Draw`.
- **Modules & filters window (`Dialog_Modules`, quick-access subset)** — opened from the log's Modules button. Left: module list; right: ignored warnings + community data; bottom: hardening. `SourceTag`/`CommunityStatus` are `internal static` here and reused by `SettingsPage` so the two surfaces can't drift on tags or status. `SourceTag` renders `MDT_TagRequires` for gated modules (e.g. the Circinus one).
- **The rule:** anything exposed on the Modules window must also be reachable from the settings page; the settings page is the superset.

### Tool 4: global knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
Source-agnostic reference browser for everything the mod knows, independent of any selected error. Suite chrome (`doWindowBackground=false`, `Margin=>0`), left rail of 8 categories + right searchable content pane; every entry cites provenance. Tabs: **Sources** (dashboard with live status + inline community-data control), **Known issues**, **Benign log lines**, **Community bugs** (our DB + `ModShippedIssues`), **Compatibility** (scoped to installed/active mods: About incompat, community RimSort rules, Use This Instead replacements), **Dependencies** (`ModDependencyIndex.All`), **Harmony patches** (lists every patched method with resolved patcher(s); `ForeignCount >= 2` = amber conflict candidate, sorted top; capped 300), **Glossary**. Read-only accessors on `CommunityData`/`HarmonyIndex`/`Glossary` feed it.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, and our own **known-issues.json** at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (PUBLIC, live). Offline snapshot ships gzipped at `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` (17 entries; edit the plain JSON then `gzip -9` back to the `.gz`, which is the shipped artifact — the plain file is not shipped). Match schema mirrors `KnownIssueDef` (exceptionTypes / keywords [lowercased substring] / regexes / namespaces / packageIds); keyword-based matching is the safe default for new entries.

### In-game reporting (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less composer; destination hierarchy: culprit mod's GitHub → its Workshop page → community Issue Form repo. Signature = FNV-1a → `[#xxxxxxxx]`. `ReportBuilder.FullReport` flattens an error's analysis to text.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph; adds category "Modern Dev Tools" with test-log/exception actions (all `Anywhere`-gated). Spawn pickers = searchable icon grid. Esc steps up one level; hides the dev palette while open; whole-tab BFS search (time-boxed, focus deferred one frame).
- **`OpenAt(node)`** — opens/reuses the window and navigates straight to any node; `TabForNode` walks up to the top-most non-root ancestor and matches it against `DebugTree.Tabs()` to pick the right tab.

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`. Resolves pinned nodes from `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette` fresh every frame; `ResolveNodes(prefIndicesOut)` also records which pref entry each row came from (unresolvable pins are skipped, so row index != pref index).
- **Label naming (`DebugTree`)**: `PrettyPrefix` = the category chain above the node, mirroring vanilla `Dialog_DevPalette.PrettifyNodeName` — walks parents but stops one level below the tab root, so the tab name ("Actions") is never shown and `"..."` is stripped; null for actions sitting directly under a tab. `PrettyLeaf` = the node's own label. `PrettyName` = flat `"prefix / leaf"` (tooltips/search). Prefixes cached by node path.
- **Row layout (`DrawRowText`, shared by real rows and the drag ghost)**: nested actions get a dim gray italic Tiny category line with the action label in white (Small) beneath; top-level actions are a single white line. Row heights derive from `Text.LineHeightOf` + `VPad` (2) − `LineOverlap` (2, pulls the leaf up into the category line's empty leading) + a 2px inter-row gap — ~12% shorter than the earlier layout without shrinking the fonts.
- **Auto-fit width**: `DesiredWidth` measures the leaf at Small and the category at Tiny and sizes the window to the widest row plus checkbox/pin/margins, clamped 220–640px. Re-fits on repaint when the count or widest label changes. Tooltip still shows the full path including the tab.
- **Browser-tab drag-to-reorder** (own drag state, ported from the user's Modern Pawn Tabs `DragState`/`TabBarInteraction` idiom — NOT vanilla `ReorderableWidget`): press anywhere on a row, move >3px (`DragThreshold`) and the row lifts; the source row becomes a hollow slot, an accent insert line marks the drop boundary (`InsertRowFor` by row centers), and a ghost plate with a drop shadow rides the cursor at the original grab offset. Drop commits to `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette` via `ApplyReorder` (row→pref index mapped through `_prefIdx`) + `Prefs.Save()`. `HandleDragInput` runs before the rows draw so it sees the raw MouseDown, and deliberately never calls `Event.Use()` on MouseUp (that would strand `GUIUtility.hotControl`); instead `_swallowClick` blocks the row action for that event. Drags never start from the thumbtack.
- **Submenu rows stay in the suite** (`Patch_DebugActionNodeEnter`): `DebugActionNode.Enter(null)` on a node WITH children makes vanilla spawn its own `Dialog_Debug`. The prefix intercepts that case and calls `Window_ModernDevActions.OpenAt(node)` instead; leaves (and calls that already carry a dialog) pass through untouched.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` → indicator → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, off by default)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`) on focus changes, NOT the mod.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`). Settings keys incl. `MDT_SettingsGeneral`, `MDT_SettingsIntro`, `MDT_NoMainMenuLog(+Desc)`, `MDT_Section*`, hardening `MDT_*Short`/`*Desc`, community `MDT_Comm*`. Knowledge-base keys `MDT_Kb*`. Glossary keys `MDT_Gl*`/`MDT_Gl*Def` (26 pairs). Circinus keys `MDT_CorpusTitle`, `MDT_ReasonCorpusCorrelation`.

## GitHub Backup
Open source (MIT). Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `origin` on Astryls; `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked; `Source/**/{bin,obj}` ignored.
